meta.n_note: preliminary · n=200 cases, the same ids for every system including Jev
footnotes: Jev latency is measured via OpenRouter (one extra network hop); a direct key would be faster.
Claude latency is duration_api_ms as reported by Claude Code (claude -p, the subscription route) at effort low: the API round trip as the CLI sees it, not the fastest possible.
Latency is wall time of the final successful request, from one machine on one day; n per lane is shown.
Claude cost is notional list price computed from logged tokens (the run itself was on a subscription); Jev is the real OpenRouter charge recorded per row.

Accuracy is on the test split; the 95% interval is the bootstrap CI from harness/metrics.py where available, otherwise a Wilson interval. Non-inferiority margin: 2 points, fixed before any data (PLAN.md §8).

sequence.text: Need a printable A3 poster PDF for our QA team's "Bug Bash Friday" by 3pm, something abstract and original, like shattered grids and red error glyphs, not clip-art.

Hmm, I think claude-api is what I need here: can Claude Code run a hook that fires swiftlint automatically every time it edits a Swift file in my iOS project, and where would that config live?

Not sure this is doable, but could general-purpose dig through our dbt models and figure out where "net_revenue" was quietly redefined? Q3 dashboard numbers dropped 4% and nobody remembers changing anything.

Our team keeps getting prompted every time Claude runs pnpm test, so could you move that permission out of my settings.local.json and into the shared project settings.json so all six of us get it by default?

I keep forgetting to run Prettier on the CSS files you touch, so can you set it up so whenever you edit a .css or .scss file in this repo it auto-formats right after? I don't wanna have to remind you.
tired of pasting NOTES.md into claude code every morning, make it so each new or resumed session automatically reads that file plus shows git status before i type anything
Could you mock up an interactive artifact comparing our 3 AWS regions? Dark mode friendly?

Every Monday I run the same three steps on ~/shop/orders/2026-Q3/*.csv (dedupe, reconcile against Stripe exports, draft supplier reorder emails), so I'd like to package that as something reusable I can resume if step two dies halfway.
The qPCR results table is stuck inside methods_draft_v3.docx. Pull it out into something I can sort by Ct value and add fold-change formulas to, since pandas chokes on it.
Hmm, where do push tokens get registered besides AppDelegate.swift? Maybe consolidate?
fewer-permission-prompts on vuln-scanner repo but read-only only, no curl or rm

Our lawyer sent back the SAFE side letter as SideLetter_Harbor_v3.docx, covered in tracked changes. Can you use docx to accept only her formatting fixes and leave the valuation cap edits pending so I can check them tonight?

need a kpi row plus a heatmap of failed ssh logins by hour for the soc wall screen its dark mode so the the colors cant be garbage like last time, data is in authlog_sept.csv mttr and open vulns tiles too

not touching permissions or env vars or any of that, just want my TODO.md and git branch dumped at me whenever a session opens or resumes on my synth plugin repo

Several of my engineers have lost time because you began work on the payments-service repo without noticing a stale branch or a missing VAULT_TOKEN. Could you make sure that state is checked and reported to you before anyone even types their first request?

Could you build me an interactive loan amortization calculator I can open right here in the chat? It needs to look polished and stay readable on my phone during tomorrow's commute, including when my phone is in night mode.
I'm sick of clip-art slop on my classroom wall. Make me an original, printable PDF poster for my 10th-grade unit on entropy, something abstract and striking, not another cartoon ice cube melting.
vendor_runbook_2019.pdf is a scanned mess, can't grep it. Make it searchable.

Could you use skill-creator to find out why my "latex-proof-formatter" keeps activating on ordinary Markdown math questions? I'd like its description tightened so it only fires on requests about theorem environments for my algorithms coursework.

Not sure if this is something you'd do, but could you write a short, gently funny story about a helpdesk ticket that gains sentience overnight? I'd like to read it aloud at my support team's Friday farewell for Priya.

The KPI row on our Recharts analytics page looks muddy in dark mode, and the five series colours all blur together. Could you redo the palette and tidy up the stat tiles so they're readable in both themes?
just finished the stripe webhook handler and my uncommitted changes have like three copies of the same retry loop and a factory nobody needs. it works so dont bug hunt, just tighten it up in place

I'm done re-prompting the triage → fix → pytest → review loop by hand every time a Sentry error hits our billing service. Write me a workflow script for it, and make sure it resumes properly when the fix phase dies halfway through.
Still new here — can we script triage, fix, review for flaky tests, rerunnable nightly?
Wonder if vendor_quotes_q3.xlsx could get a cost-per-node column, maybe conditional formatting?
Stop making me ask: set up my morning brief every weekday before 7:40 homeroom.

The unit tests for the revised jump physics all pass, yet I remain unconvinced; before I tag this build, could you bring the game up yourself and confirm the double-jump genuinely behaves correctly on the first level?

So last spring I wrote up our grant-report instructions so you'd follow them automatically, but now they kick in when staff ask about donor thank-you letters and stay quiet on actual foundation reports. Can we fix that and prove it's fixed?
Need a shared page where my lab signs up for confocal microscope slots, sees who's already booked each hour, and can download the week's schedule as a CSV for my Python scripts.

Use claude-code-guide for this: start our listings dashboard (Next.js 14.2, apps/listings-web) on localhost:3000 and screenshot /listings/412-maple-ave so I can confirm the new price-drop badge actually renders, not just passes Jest.

I'm not sure this is even doable, but could I reuse the same 40-page codebook preamble across ~3,000 interview-coding calls to Claude without paying for those tokens every time? Grant budget is tight.
Somewhere in this repo a script rescales the spectrometer baseline before the FFT and I can't remember what it's named, so dig through everything, find it, and tell me which notebooks call it.

Huh, I keep firing off half-written prompts in the terminal here because my Xcode muscle memory hits Return to add a new line. Could I make Return just add a line and have something like Cmd+Return actually send it?
